title: Fila virtual for the customer
summary: The customer joins a business's queue of the day from the counter QR code, its profile or the chat, sees the position and a wait range, and can leave. A card in the chat shows the place while it is active (ADR 0107).

customerUserId.description: Signed-in customer. Absent for a name-only walk-in.

customerName.description: Name-only walk-in typed by the owner.

place.description: The caller's active place from GET .../queue/me.

waitMin.description: Wait range lower bound in minutes.

waitMax.description: Wait range upper bound in minutes.

load.effect: Reads the queue and the caller's place. While the screen or the chat card shows and the place is active, reads again every 30 seconds.

join.effect: POST .../queue/join. already_in_queue shows bipe_queue_error_already_joined; queue_closed shows bipe_queue_closed. Success shows bipe_queue_joined.

notes: The counter QR code holds https://bipe.chat/@<handle>?fila. The app opens queue-customer for it; the site shows the profile with Baixe o Bipe.
Bipe never asks for the customer's location (ADR 0107).
The wait is a range and an estimate (bipe_queue_estimate_hint); with no data it says bipe_queue_wait_unknown, never zero.
Push when 2 people are ahead and when called waits for the push path (bipe-chat/bipe#320); until then the screen reads again while open.
